doc_title: STATUTORY DECLARATION BY A BODY CORPORATE
doc_title_official: STATUTORY DECLARATION BY A BODY CORPORATE
when_used: A director swears for a company that its certificate of title or lease has been lost or destroyed, in support of an application for a replacement.
pre_title_lines: IN THE MATTER OF AN APPLICATION FOR A

body_text.text: of National Identity Card Number [or Passport Number] {{declarant_id_number}}
SOLEMNLY AND SINCERELY DECLARE as follows:-
THAT I am a director of {{company_name}}
(“the Company”) and duly authorized to swear this affidavit on behalf of the Company.

THAT the Company is the registered proprietor of ALL THAT piece of land known as Title Number {{property_lr_no}} together with the improvements erected and being thereon (“the Property”). Attached herewith and marked {{exhibit_mark_search}} is an official search of the register relating to the Property issued within 30 days of this declaration by the {{land_registry}} Land registry on {{search_date}}.
THAT the title to the Property is comprised in a Certificate of Title/Lease.

THAT the original Certificate of Title/Lease relating to the Property has been lost and/or misplaced and despite all efforts to search for it among the Company’s records and documents, I have failed to trace or find the said Certificate of Title/Lease and I verily believe that the same has been lost and cannot be found. A Police Abstract reporting the loss of the said Certificate of Title/Lease is attached and marked “{{exhibit_mark_abstract}}”

THAT the original Certificate of Title/Lease relating to the Property has been destroyed by {{cause_of_destruction}}. A Police Abstract reporting the destruction of the said Certificate of Title/Lease is attached and marked “{{exhibit_mark_abstract}}”

THAT I hereby confirm that the said Certificate of Title/Lease has not been deposited by way of pledge or given as security for a loan to any person, firm, company, bank or any financial institution other than as stated in the official search.
THAT I shall return the Certificate of Title/Lease to the Land Registrar whenever the same is found.

THAT I make this declaration in support of an application made under the Land Registration Act 2012 to the Land Registrar seeking a replacement Certificate of Title/Lease in lieu of the aforesaid lost/destroyed document and make this declaration conscientiously believing the same to be true and according to the Oaths and Statutory Declarations Act.

custom_fields.name: declarant_name
custom_fields.label: Name of the declarant
custom_fields.prompt: Full name of the director swearing this declaration for the company

custom_fields.label: Identity card or passport number of the declarant

custom_fields.label: Postal address of the declarant
custom_fields.prompt: Postal address of the declarant: box number, code, town and country

custom_fields.name: company_name
custom_fields.label: Name of the Company
custom_fields.prompt: Registered name of the body corporate that is the registered proprietor

custom_fields.name: company_address
custom_fields.label: Address of the Company
custom_fields.prompt: Registered or postal address of the Company

custom_fields.name: company_registration_no
custom_fields.label: Registration number of the Company
custom_fields.prompt: Company registration number, for example CPR/2010/123456

custom_fields.name: exhibit_mark_search
custom_fields.label: Exhibit mark for the official search
custom_fields.prompt: The mark the official search is annexed under, for example RM1

custom_fields.name: land_registry
custom_fields.label: Land registry that issued the search
custom_fields.prompt: The land registry the official search was issued by, for example Nairobi

custom_fields.name: search_date
custom_fields.label: Date of the official search
custom_fields.prompt: The date the official search was issued, within 30 days of this declaration

custom_fields.name: exhibit_mark_abstract
custom_fields.label: Exhibit mark for the Police Abstract
custom_fields.prompt: The mark the Police Abstract is annexed under, for example RM2

custom_fields.name: cause_of_destruction
custom_fields.label: How the title was destroyed
custom_fields.prompt: What destroyed the certificate of title or lease, for example fire at the Company's offices
